text:
lina (Marketing): Quick pass — finalizing the benchmark narrative for launch. Need a short pitch that ties latency -> user value -> $ savings for SMBs. Can we land on 3 charts + a 1-sentence hook each?

sam (Growth): Love it. Targeting SMB dev teams? we should lead with: faster responses -> more retained sessions -> lower cost per active user.

ito (Data Viz): I can make 3 small charts:
- 1: token-cost vs latency scatter (showing real tradeoffs)
- 2: tail latency CDF (percentiles matter for UX)
- 3: throughput $/1000 reqs (economics by batch size)

ben (Product): For hooks:
- Chart 1 hook: "Same output quality, half the wait = 2x engaged demos"
- Chart 2 hook: "99th pct latency drives churn — optimize tail not just mean"
- Chart 3 hook: "Smart batching & cache = predictable $/k requests"

mike (ML): Data notes: our microbench has 3 model families; attach sample numbers. We should call out quantization tradeoffs explicitly.

lina (Marketing): @ito can you mock visuals with annotations that call out the decision points? e.g., where to choose latency over cost. Need them sized for a social card + slide.

ito (Data Viz): Yep. Draft sizes: 1200x628 (card), 1024x512 (slide strip). I'll annotate 3 decision anchors: "fastpath", "sweetspot", "low-cost".

tori (Design): I'll layer consistent colors + simple labels. Avoid heavy axis ticks. Use a small caption line under each chart: 1-sentence why this matters to the buyer.

sam (Growth): Inbound routing idea: use a triage form with 2 fields: "priority" (latency-sensitive / cost-sensitive / both) and "scale" (poc / production). Route latency-sensitive leads to a performance CTA + demo. Cost-sensitive gets an econ one-pager + ROI calc.

ben (Product): For the one-pager, include a microcase: "SaaS support bot — 50ms vs 300ms: conversion delta X, cost delta Y". We have numbers from customer POC #4. @mike can you paste them?

mike (ML): POC #4 summary:
```
baseline: 300ms p50, 2.1x tokens/sec cost factor
optimized: 55ms p50, 1.3x tokens/sec cost factor
user-engagement delta: +18% in task completion
estimated cost saving: ~27% per 1M tokens
```

lina (Marketing): Perfect. We'll spin that into an "SMB starter" narrative. Keep claims conservative: "~20% engagement lift; up to 25% token cost savings depending on workload".

ito (Data Viz): Mock charts will use POC #4 numbers plus synthetic points for different batch/quantization combos. I'll drop them in Figma by EOD.

qa-bot: File uploaded: /benchmarks/po4_summary.csv (sha256: ab12...)

tori (Design): Quick ask: make the social card copy hero line < 90 chars. Lina can you draft 2 variants?

lina (Marketing): Variant A: "Faster responses, better demos — benchmarked for real apps."
Variant B: "Cut wait times, boost demo conversions — see the benchmark."

sam (Growth): A/B test both in the same segment. Use CTA variants: "Run a quick demo" vs "See our cost calculator".

ben (Product): Checklist before launch:
- final charts (ito)
- one-pager + microcase (lina + mike)
- routing form + CTAs (sam)
- assets in drive + tracking tags (tori)
- sign-off on wording (legal)

lina (Marketing): I'll get legal sign-off on conservative numbers. Also recording request: can we add a short explainer gif showing tail latency effect?

ito (Data Viz): GIF OK — simple animated CDF shifting right. I can export 2 variants: subtle and pronounced.

mike (ML): Note for materials: call out assumptions: prompt length, token mix, model family, quantization. Avoid absolute $ claims without that.

lina (Marketing): Agreed. Final ask: everyone, drop final assets by 1719990255 (end of day) and I'll assemble the launch thread + webinar invite. Thanks all :rocket:
